audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Sett levels 1-3 while every content 'why' line on the same page says Pantheon owns levels 1-3 and Sett takes over from 4.
audit.why: The packet chart for this pairing is Pantheon/Pantheon/Pantheon/Sett/Sett/Sett/Sett, which matches the prose. Comet Spear (575) out-ranges Sett's fists and Shield Vault is a point-and-click dash-stun, so the early rows are his.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3, 5 and 6 flipped to the packet chart as matched full+content pairs with ratings; row 4 already read Sett.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 spike claimed R 'answers his roam/engage' without saying how.
audit.why: The Show Stopper grounds — Shield Vault (W) and Grand Starfall (R) are both dashes, so the grab shuts them off. That is the actual level-6 swing.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now names the grounding and both dashes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault was never mentioned anywhere on the page, and a 'W execute' was invented in the don'ts.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (E, 400 range, 22/21/20/19/18s) is a CHANNEL that makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT while he strikes — so Facebreaker or The Show Stopper cancels it outright, and punching into its face is the single biggest way to waste a Haymaker. Nothing in Pantheon's kit text executes.
audit.corrected: mid, spikes[0], breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1] and report[11] now state the channel, the front-only invulnerability and the cancel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown panel duplicated Shield Vault with no numbers.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 600 range on 13/12/11/10/9s and resets his auto-attack — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t carry the numbers; the duplicate line is replaced with Aegis Assault.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Pantheon on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Comet Spear out-ranges your fists at 575 and Mortal Will empowers his next spell, so level 1 is his. Farm it out, let the poke bank Grit, and wait until Facebreaker is up.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Pantheon and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before he can answer with Shield Vault (Stun).
edits.after: Shield Vault is a 600-range dash-stun on 13s and it resets his auto, so his level-2 all-in beats yours. Trade only once it has been spent.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Pantheon burns Shield Vault (Stun).
edits.after: Facebreaker is online, but level 3 is still his spike — bait Shield Vault, then pull him across your minions and cash the W panel.

edits.before: Careful early: Pantheon's Q Comet Spear poke and W Shield Vault point-and-click stun let him win the first levels, but from Level 4 you stabilize — bait his W stun then all-in with E-Facebreaker once it's on cooldown.
edits.after: Careful early: Comet Spear poke and a point-and-click Shield Vault stun win him the first levels. From Level 4 you stabilise — Facebreaker cancels Aegis Assault outright, so save your E for that channel, not for the wave.

edits.before: You turn the corner at 6: R The Show Stopper answers his roam/engage, and once you're on top of him Haymaker true damage plus Grit out-brawl his front-loaded early kit.
edits.after: You turn the corner at 6: The Show Stopper grounds, shutting off both Shield Vault and Grand Starfall, and Haymaker's true-damage centre out-brawls his front-loaded kit.

edits.before: The lane stabilizes from Level 4 and swings to you by 6. Once you can bait his W stun and answer with E Facebreaker plus Q Knuckle Down, his front-loaded burst runs out and your Grit sustain shrugs off Comet Spear poke. R gives you an engage/answer tool he can't match.
edits.after: The lane stabilises from Level 4 and swings to you by 6. Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front only and is a channel — Facebreaker cancels it, or step behind him. Once that 22s E is spent his burst is gone and Grit eats the Comet Spear poke.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — His all-in start. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Pantheon Shield Vault: Leaps to a target, stuns, and strikes — his all-in start. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (W, 600 range, 13s at rank 1): a dash-stun that resets his auto — the wind-up is your cue. - Pantheon Aegis Assault (E, 22s at rank 1): a channel your Facebreaker cancels outright.
